title: Onboarding completion depends on the finish definition
method: Synthetic nested cohort: qualifying completion=15/30=50%; deployment-only=18/30=60%. Stages are not additive; include abandoned and assisted attempts.
alt: Onboarding completion depends on the finish definition: Started 30 developers, Built 24 developers, Deployed 18 developers, Qualified 15 developers. Illustrative inputs.
